model: known-density flat 2+1 Minkowski, complete exact causal order

selection.rule: Freeze root/support/first3 on A; stable mark order on each complete common cone, require comparability and full16/half4 counts before first128 cap; same Gram/moment gates and minimum Gram-condition choice. B never influences selection.

count_covariance: intersection counts for every pair of measured intervals, including shared landmark/root intervals; conditional on A, unbiased estimate of rho_B times overlap volume
negative_control: replace interval-count covariance by its diagonal before propagation
gate_scope: All selection gates for SELECTION_PILOT_SUPPORTED; all selection and operator gates for OPERATOR_PILOT_SUPPORTED. Neither lifts global HOLDs. One-sided exact paired discordance test is descriptive for this pilot; no repeated-testing or portfolio-wide error control.
freeze: local code/input hash and UTC timestamp before first new A or B cloud
comparison: Legacy first128-then-eligibility versus eligibility-then-first128, same fresh A, same base selection and same independent B clouds. Unchanged direct four-landmark inversion; no Poisson/GLS retuning.
qualification: Full observed causal order still required. Changed fourth landmark may change weights; monotone availability and better A Gram condition do not imply better B operator accuracy.
propagation: Unchanged full interval-overlap covariance and first-order delta propagation. B0 covariance predicts B1..B8 response spread; conditional plug-in approximation, not coverage certification.
